name: Mossmarch
silhouette: A short six-legged caterpillar-like animal with a square muzzle, four separated moss cushions and a bare expressive brow.
motion: Six legs ripple in three pairs while cushions squash in sequence.

name: Trellislong
silhouette: A long high-arched six-legged crawler with an open lattice of connected moss ribs above its smooth living underside and wide face.
motion: Three alternating leg pairs carry a traveling body arch, never a static stretched base sprite.

name: Dripurchin
silhouette: A low sea-urchin-like animal with a soft visible face, five blunt movable spines and three rounded tube feet.
motion: Rotates its feet without rotating its face, then bobs with gathered droplets.

name: Dewmedusa
silhouette: A tall soft-bodied urchin with its five spines opened into curved umbrella ribs and long joined tube-foot tassels; face hangs below the cap.
motion: Gentle pulse-lift then trailing-foot settle; a grounded shadow makes its location legible.

name: Hingelet
silhouette: Small plated shrew with an upturned ear hinge, long whiskers, pointed soft muzzle and one curled copper tail; not a tool on feet
motion: Sniffs, ear turns independently, then tiny paws sidestep the seam

name: Hushhinge
silhouette: Low long-backed plated shrew with tall open crescent ears, an arched connected neck and two delicate whisker fans
motion: Turns the head before the body, unfolds one ear, then scampers under it

name: Rillkite
silhouette: Glass-finned living mudskipper with a small smile, two long bowed pectoral fins and a single fan tail; neither seal nor water ring
motion: Fin-walks with a forward bob, then lifts the tail for a short skim

name: Wakebraid
silhouette: Long mudskipper with joined broad forefins forming an open shallow arch and a braided-looking continuous tail crest; face leads the body
motion: Wide fin-step, low bank and double tail-settle

name: Lintail
silhouette: A slim leaf-furred marten with a cream triangular face, tiny round ears and one forked leaf tail; separated front paws and long rear body distinguish it from Hingelet.
motion: Bounds low, tail forks close on landing; casts plant paws, stretch one tail ribbon, then recoil.

name: Loomarten
silhouette: Long upright marten with two connected leafy shoulder pennants, a slim visible waist, short round ears and the same single split tail; open space between raised arms and chest.
motion: Forepaw step then trailing-tail sweep; casts gather shoulder pennants, weave an angled hem, then fold them.

name: Cindercup
silhouette: A round orange puffin-like chick with a pale bowl-shaped down collar, short dark bill, tiny separate wings and broad charcoal feet; breast remains a living face-bearing body.
motion: Short alternating waddles; collar contracts, receives a warm ember, then opens with a soft pulse.

name: Mantlewick
silhouette: Tall rounded wading bird with a continuous hood of warm down, long exposed neck, two short wing elbows and broad grounded feet; retains Cindercup's dark bill and pale collar.
motion: Slow neck-leading steps; hood closes, one wing cups a coal, then the hood settles.

name: Talusnip
silhouette: A pointed-nosed armadillo with three pale overlapping shoulder bands, low upright ears, a bare face and a broad flattened fan tail; no shell dome or goat horns.
motion: Front claws tap twice before hindfeet catch up; casts fan the tail, lean forward, then resettle.

name: Stratodillo
silhouette: Long low armadillo with four raised offset shoulder bands, two wide digging forepaws and a tall open fan tail; a diagonal gap separates bands from its snout.
motion: Heavy front-left/front-right tread with delayed fan-tail sway; casts brace, press two distinct beats, then relax.

name: Gleamray
silhouette: A small diamond freshwater ray with curled pectoral tips used as feet, two high bright eyes, a pale smiling underside and one slender tail; grounded, not free-swimming.
motion: Alternating fin-tip steps and a soft back ripple; casts cup the fins, tilt a clear water lens, then flatten.

name: Foldcurrent
silhouette: Wide connected ray fins fold into an asymmetric W around an exposed central face; long tail ends in a single broad fan, with open fin arches above the ground.
motion: Fin arches alternate like a walking cloth; casts fold one wing, release two unequal glints, then lower.

name: Rivetusk
silhouette: A squat russet boar with a blunt living snout, two unequal flat silver tusks, a square mane and a short corkscrew tail; tusks sit beside the face, never replace it.
motion: Shoulder-led trot with snout bob; casts align tusks, flick one forward, then stamp.

name: Furlace
silhouette: A pale green lacewing with two broad scalloped net wings held sideways, an expressive small head and two forked antennae; six little feet hang below its continuous body.
motion: Wing tips alternately dip above a grounded shadow; casts fold to a narrow pleat, unfold a shelter arc, then shake it closed.

name: Kilnspoke
silhouette: A rust-red scorpion with two narrow blunt claws, four readable leg pairs and a rounded warm lantern at the end of its single curved tail; large attentive eyes above its mouth.
motion: Leg pairs ripple while the tail counterbalances; casts lower claws, sweep the tail sideways, then curl it back.

name: Chalkox
silhouette: A compact chalk-white ox with a broad square muzzle, a hanging scalloped dewlap, two low crescent horns and four dark hooves; heavy rectangular outline distinct from the stone goats.
motion: Deliberate square steps; casts lower the dewlap, plant both forehooves, then raise the head.

name: Tinshear
silhouette: A dragonfly with four separate spatula-shaped metal wings, a long jointed tail and two huge soft eyes; no folded bird chest or mantis claws.
motion: Wings alternate in paired shallow strokes; casts draw them inward, sound two unequal clicks, then spread.

name: Rippleback
silhouette: A flat round softshell turtle with a long flexible snout, four clearly separated paddle feet and one low translucent rim; no amber plates, clam valves or arch shell.
motion: Alternating paddles slide under the rim; casts lift the snout, splash outward twice, then tuck.

name: Tetherasp
silhouette: A short leaf-green snake with a broad friendly wedge head and three joined leaf cuffs; its single bare tail rests outside an asymmetric S curve, with no metal collars or eel fins.
motion: A traveling S wave with head held steady; casts draw a cuff inward, lay one root seam, then smooth it flat.

name: Cymbalop
silhouette: A small pearl-gray rabbit with two broad round metal ears held at unequal angles, stubby soft paws and a tiny round tail; a short wide body distinguishes it from the long-eared dune mammal.
motion: Paired hindfoot hops with ears swinging in opposite directions; casts cup ears, clap one bright impulse, then bounce back.

name: Stilltide Orrery
silhouette: Three independent water arcs revolve around a small dark pebble, with a clear central void and no animal head.
motion: Each arc slows separately when absorbing a shot, then realigns into a quiet orbit.
role: Legendary projectile defense and delayed counterplay
